svg.title: Both capstone packets share one shape: state changes first, a callee can fail, and the visible return skips the ordinary cleanup
svg.desc: Two lanes. Packet A, routed as VS-11: the atomic latch tuple is updated first, then the per-thread holder is allocated by a callee that may return NULL; on success the holder is recorded and a page pointer is returned, while the visible failure path returns ER_FAILED after an assertion with no local rollback of the grant. Packet B, routed as VS-12: FLUSHING is set and DIRTY cleared first, then TDE encryption of the copy or DWB slot reservation may fail; on success the LSAs are copied, the BCB is released, WAL is forced, and the image is submitted, and a later I/O failure reaches the ordinary rollback that restores DIRTY and the lower bound; the visible early return leaves before that rollback block. A footer states that the source establishes control flow only, that reachability, surviving state, and impact need fault injection on the target revision, and that status lives only in the uncertainty registry.
svg.text: Packets A and B share one shape: changed state, a fallible callee, an early return
PACKET A · VS-11 · per-thread holder allocated after the grant
State changed first
atomic latch tuple updated
by compare-exchange:
mode set, global fcnt +1
Fallible callee
pgbuf_allocate_thrd_holder_entry()
runs after the BCB mutex is
released; it may return NULL
Success: holder recorded, PAGE_PTR returned
fix_count = 1 for a new holder, or the nested count +1 for an existing one
Visible early return: ER_FAILED after assert(false)
no local rollback of the atomic grant is visible in this snippet
Sites: normal hit, awakened waiter, lock-free READ hit. Each has its own cleanup seam, so each must be injected separately.
PACKET B · VS-12 · flush setup before the ordinary rollback
State changed first
FLUSHING set, DIRTY cleared
by pgbuf_bcb_mark_is_flushing();
the BCB mutex is still held
Fallible callees
TDE encryption of the copy;
DWB slot reservation
(when DWB is configured)
Success: copy LSAs, release the BCB, force WAL, submit
a later I/O failure reaches the ordinary rollback, which restores
DIRTY and the copied lower bound, then wakes flush waiters
Visible early return: the callee's error is returned
before that rollback block; no restoration of DIRTY or
oldest_unflush_lsa is visible on the local path
A concurrent re-dirty during the window is a separate schedule to test; it is not covered by the single-thread injection.
What the source establishes, and what it does not
Source shows the control flow. Reachability, surviving state, and impact need fault injection on the target revision. Status lives only in the uncertainty registry.
